digest.component_or_area: tickets branch reclaim and epoch migration
propositions: Execute a quiesced, operator-gated, agent-executed reclaim window on the tickets branch to reduce size from 1.04 GiB to ≤150 MB via history rewrite, guarded by epoch-mismatch refusal and non-resurrection assertions.

Disable GitHub reconcile workflows, pause AWS timer and host LaunchAgents, verify no reconcile run in progress, drain the review-bot queue (in_flight==0), and confirm zero active sessions and stopped rebar-mcp servers before entering the reclaim window.

Refresh the host rebar runtime from a descendant of the A6-0a merge, run an epoch-mismatch refusal probe against it, record the executable path/version, and verify the deployed review-bot runtime via live refusal probe.

Converge all local tracker worktrees (symlinked to one store), delete pre-rewrite ref pins, execute the strip in a fresh unfiltered clone, verify pre-push assertions, and force-push with --force-with-lease to origin/tickets.

After the rewrite, assert non-resurrection by confirming the old tip is not an ancestor of origin/tickets, measure size-pack growth <1 MB from the first post-window write, and verify no fetched ref has the old tip as an ancestor.

Land the identity.enforce_since re-pin through Gerrit mapped from the post-rewrite SHA, record the vote as the deterministic first post-window write, converge the review-bot clone over SSM, re-enable workflows/timers/LaunchAgents, and verify reconciler green and rebar fsck clean.
